predeclaration_before_any_gpu_dispatch.W0_rule: diagnostic only — NO selection; report paired per-seed differences overlay-vs-control
predeclaration_before_any_gpu_dispatch.W1_selection_rule: among cells with 100% closure compliance and zero unresolved incidents, select the maximum mean calibration primary endpoint; ties within one standard error resolve toward LARGER wind_down_hours, then LARGER forced_flatten_hours (both conservative). The selected timing freezes W2.
predeclaration_before_any_gpu_dispatch.W2_rule: gated on the frozen W1 timing; same endpoint; ties resolve toward the LONGER blackout (larger hours, then bars, then checks)
predeclaration_before_any_gpu_dispatch.multiple_testing: within each family, Holm-Bonferroni on paired per-seed differences versus the section-4 default cell, family alpha 0.05; W0 exempt (diagnostic, no selection)
predeclaration_before_any_gpu_dispatch.no_post_result_additions: grids, endpoints, rules and trial counts are fixed here, before any training exists

boundaries: No training, no GPU, no complete economic W1/W2 grids, no deployment, no services, no venue connections, no commands, no position changes, no checkpoint promotion, no live activation. Any GPU campaign requires Musashi's separate dispatch over this predeclaration.
